questions.text: Describe a time when you tried something for the first time.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you tried something for the first time. You should say: what you tried; when and where you tried it; who you were with; and explain how you felt about trying this new thing.

questions.text: Have you done it again since then?
questions.say: Thank you. Have you done it again since then?

questions.text: Why do some people enjoy trying new things while others don't?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you tried something new, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all new experiences. Why do some people enjoy trying new things while others don't?

questions.text: Is it easier for young people to try new things than for older people?

questions.text: How do new experiences help people to develop?

questions.text: In what situations is it a good idea to take a risk?
